description: This file defines the ErrorHandlingMiddleware class, which provides ASP.NET Core middleware for globally handling exceptions during HTTP request processing. It captures exceptions, logs unhandled errors, and returns standardized JSON error responses.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling exceptions in an ASP.NET Core application, logging errors, and returning appropriate JSON responses.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Entry point for the middleware, executes the next delegate and catches exceptions to handle them.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by setting response status codes and body based on exception type, logs unhandled exceptions.
